title: 有馬記念の後に・惜敗と稲妻

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having lost to Super Creek in the Arima Kinen, Oguri Cap vows to defeat her next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Tamamo Cross visits the waiting room and declares she's postponing competing for the Dream Trophy in order to face off against Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The appearance of an unexpected rival marks the start of a new period of training for Oguri Cap.
